description: This Java source file defines the class TaskThreadedInitializationWrapper, which wraps a Task to run its initialization asynchronously in a separate thread and manages synchronization to ensure the task is initialized before execution.

classes.name: TaskThreadedInitializationWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing Task that runs the initialize method in a separate thread and ensures the task is initialized before execution.

methods.name: TaskThreadedInitializationWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that takes a Task object to wrap.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the wrapped task only after initialization has completed, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Starts the task initialization asynchronously in a new thread and signals when done.

methods.name: getTaskDefinition
methods.description: Returns the task definition from the wrapped task.

methods.name: isExecuting
methods.description: Delegates to the wrapped task's isExecuting method.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Delegates to the wrapped task's shutdown method.
